detail.command: echo '== spawn/cup по курсам (x:z -> x:z) =='; for f in ancient-temple arctic-base volcano green-hills chaos-dimension; do echo "-- $f"; grep -o "spawn: { x: [-0-9.]*, y: [-0-9.]*, z: [-0-9.]* }" src/courses/data/$f.ts | sed 's/spawn: { x: //; s/, y: [-0-9.]*, z: /  z=/; s/ }//' | head -9; done 2>&1 | cut -c1-80; echo; echo '== размеры полов =='; for f in ancient-temple arctic-base volcano; do echo -n "$f floors: "; grep -o "size: { x: [0-9.]*, y: 0.5, z: [0-9.]* }" src/courses/data/$f.ts | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-260; echo; done; echo; echo '== флаг и тема в билдере =='; grep -c '' src/core/HoleSceneBuilder.ts; grep -n 'flag\|Flag\|cone\|Cone\|theme\|Theme\|background\|fog' src/core/HoleSceneBuilder.ts src/game/Game.ts | cut -c1-130 | head -25
